columns.name: PROCESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Specifies the category of the bulk advisor job.

columns.name: HCM_LIST_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the HCM List which represents a list of learning items.

columns.name: PROVIDER_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the external provider configuration account.

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Specifies the process name used to generate skills for the learning items.

columns.name: PROCESS_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Specifies the process description used to generate skills for the learning items.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Specfies status of the process used to generate skills for the learning items.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.description: Captures the additional metadate information specific to a given bulk advisor request

columns.name: LATEST_PROCESSING_JOB_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the latest ESS job used to process the skills for the list of learning items.

columns.name: LATEST_PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Specfies the timestamp when the process used to generate skills for the learning items is completed.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the person who created the process.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
